title: Repair Order
description: The work order for one visit — what the truck came in for, who's paying, and everything that got done to it.
x-sap-analogue: Internal order (AUFK/COEP) with a settlement rule splitting cost across customer/warranty/internal payers
x-api-note: Get Repair Order v3 on Fortellis is the deepest documented object in the whole platform — full header, labor, parts, sublet, and technician punch detail.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.
